name: sdd-engineering
description: Spec-driven development pipeline: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents, plus run-plan, workflow-retro and engineering-insights skills, for taking a requirement from an evidence-based specification through an AC-linked plan, implementation, architecture/research review, and closed-list verification. Depends on engineering-paved-path for domain skills, research-tools for the researcher subagent, and architecture-review for the architecture-reviewer subagent.
